standard-dialogue.npc: What are you doing down here?

options.text: Could you explain this place to me again?

steps.player: Could you explain this place to me again?

steps.npc: This here is the Gauntlet, the finest creation of the Amlodd clan. It was built years ago to help train Prifddinas' finest warriors and survivalists.
That's right. The Gauntlet contains a range of deadly creatures formed from crystal. Defeating them is the key to victory, but it is no easy task.
This is because all participants start with nothing at hand beyond a few basic tools.

steps.player: But how do people fight without their gear?

steps.npc: Resources can be gathered throughout the dungeon. These can be used to create the weapons, armour, food and potions needed to survive.
Without any armour, those crystalline creatures can be real nasty. Any armour that you make down there will greatly reduce the damage they do to you.

steps.player: Okay, I think I follow... But I thought this was all about combat, not just gathering my own equipment.

steps.npc: That's right. Once you feel you're ready, or once we decide that you've spent long enough down there, you'll have to face the fearsome Crystalline Hunllef.

steps.player: And what makes it so dangerous, if it's just for training?

steps.npc: Once you go down there, there are only two ways out... You can make a break for the exit, or if you're bested in combat we'll send someone in for you.

steps.text: The Gauntlet is not a safe environment, and teleports are blocked inside! If you die in there, any items stored at a gravestone will be lost!

steps.npc: Things can be a little unstable down there at times, too... Everything gets corrupted, and it might be a little frightening, but it makes for a good challenge.

steps.text: The Corrupted Gauntlet can be accessed by rightclicking the entrance.

steps.npc: I think that covers it... Everything else, you'll have to work out for yourself while you're in there.

steps.player: Okay... I think I've got it.

steps.npc: You can always come back and ask me to go over things again.

options.text: I'm thinking of giving the Gauntlet a go.

steps.player: I'm thinking of giving the Gauntlet a go.

steps.npc: You? Attempting the Gauntlet? If you say so!

Alright... Well be careful down here. I've got my eye on you.

first-time-talking-to-him-attemping-to-e.npc: Don't think you want to be heading down there without knowing what you're getting into! Come and see me, if you really want to go down there.
Don't think you can be taking any plus ones down there with you.

first-time-talking-to-him-attempting-to-.npc: There's something in that there chest waiting for you. Don't leave it for too long.
Hey! Finish your fight before you come in here!

first-time-talking-to-him-completing-the.npc: You know, if things start getting comfortable down there, things can be a little unstable at times.
It might be a little frightening, but it makes for a good challenge!

first-time-talking-to-him-completing-the.player: Maybe I'll check it out at some point!
